definition: Autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 29 (LGMDR29, OMIM #620793) is a neuromuscular disorder caused by biallelic variants in the SNUPN gene (encoding snurportin-1). Clinically, it encompasses a phenotypic spectrum ranging from congenital or childhood-onset muscular dystrophy characterized by proximal muscle weakness, restrictive respiratory involvement, and contractures, to adult-onset proximo-distal and axial weakness with early respiratory impairment, as well as complex syndromic presentations associated with neurodevelopmental features, cataracts, or spinocerebellar ataxia. Pathologically and radiologically, it often exhibits myofibrillar-like changes and distinct patterns of muscle involvement.

source.title: SNUPN‐Related Muscular Dystrophy: Novel Phenotypic, Pathological and Functional Protein Insights
source.quote: SNUPN-related muscular dystrophy or LGMDR29 is a new entity that covers from a congenital or childhood onset pure muscular dystrophy to more complex phenotypes combining neurodevelopmental features, cataracts, or spinocerebellar ataxia.
